_comment: Single source of truth for long-form Journal articles, newest first. Edit this, then run: node build.mjs. It regenerates the article cards on the homepage and Journal page, the article URLs in sitemap.xml, and the Articles section of llms.txt. LinkedIn/partnership cards are managed separately in the HTML.

articles.title: I Don't Code. I Brief Agents.
articles.alt: I Don't Code. I Brief Agents. An essay by Prateek Saxena
articles.excerpt: Agentic AI from the operator's chair: how business operators and teams turn intent into working software by briefing AI agents, not writing code.
articles.llmsTitle: I Don't Code. I Brief Agents. (In a Suit, No. 2)
articles.llmsDesc: Essay by Prateek Saxena on agentic AI from the operator's chair: briefing AI agents to turn business intent into dashboards, tools and working software inside real company processes. Second entry in the "In a Suit" series.

articles.title: Confessions of an Accidental Vibe Coder
articles.alt: Vibe Coding in a Suit, an essay by Prateek Saxena
articles.excerpt: How a UAE business operator started building software by briefing AI agents instead of writing code. I call it vibe coding in a suit.
articles.llmsTitle: Confessions of an Accidental Vibe Coder (Vibe Coding in a Suit)
articles.llmsDesc: Essay by Prateek Saxena on "vibe coding in a suit": a business operator using AI agents and plain-language briefing, not code, to build the dashboards and tools a company needs. First entry in the "In a Suit" series.

articles.title: After the Prompt: The Operator’s Harness
articles.alt: After the Prompt: The Operator’s Harness
articles.excerpt: Prompt engineering helped us talk to AI. Harness engineering is how we make AI work — and why every serious AI agent needs a Self-Improvement Protocol.
articles.llmsTitle: After the Prompt: The Operator's Harness
articles.llmsDesc: Essay by Prateek Saxena on harness engineering for real businesses, the operator's lens, and the Self-Improvement Protocol (SIP) for making AI agents improve safely.
